author: 5thteen
body:
Name: 5thteen
Reason: Auto-clicking
Why I should be unbanned?: Because I didn't auto-click

Since my time on the server, I have only ever used optifine as a mod, which I believe is allowed by the server. I have however NEVER used auto-clicker as a way to gain advantage.
I have never received a ban before, nor have I ever appealed to one.

Since I can't go on the server to prove my innocence, the are pictures to which it only shows that I use optifine as a mod, and that the files details have been left untouched for over months:
http://s12.photobucket.com/user/5thteengaming/library/?view=recent&page=1

I was banned by Jozzmcozz, in which I cannot see how they thought that the said infraction I did was a bannable offence.
With this:
http://s12.photobucket.com/user/5thteengaming/media/Evidence/jocomzm%20stat_zpsg51o63h3.png.html?fil...
I cannot see how the mod can adjudge me with autoclick when out of the 4 times that we faced, they killed me twice!

Now if I were supposedly used autoclick, surely I would of  killed them more often??
It is also very hard to judge someone of autoclick after 2 deaths, especially if crits were involved. Also the map we were playing on, Rendezvous 1, has iron swords at the start of each game, so I can see how the mod thought I was autoclicking as iron swords compared to stone sword have a much more advantage and it makes it look like the opponent is killing you faster. So I'm not saying that the mod is rubbish, but it was simply a lack of judgement and possibly that of haste.

I have been on this server for over a year now, I have never been banned once before this incident, why would I use autoclick now?

I hope you consider the ban wisely and I thank you for your time reading this.


Sincerly  

                               5th

title: Appealing my Infraction

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

This infraction is only a temp-ban which ends on the 5th of May.

This appeal is denied. 

Reason: There are more ways than just a MC mod to obtain such effects like Auto clicker.
Plus it's only a temp-ban. You'll live.
